name: bubblefish/naalp
description: Reference implementation of N-AALP (Native Agentic Application Layer Protocol), draft-bubblefish-naalp-00 — PHP port: the signed object envelope (deterministic CBOR + COSE_Sign1), self-certifying identity, the effect/authorization lattice, the spine record bodies, causal + federation ordering, and the twenty-channel registry. Pure surface + Ed25519 (RFC 8032), verifiable offline over any transport.
